name: Shang Gong Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shang Gong Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of sewing equipment, intelligent manufacturing equipment, auto parts, and light sport aircraft in China and internationally. The company offers sewing equipment, including industrial sewing machines, automatic sewing workstations, and household sewing machines; intelligent manufacturing equipment, such as various flexible material intelligent connection processing equipment and its components; auto parts comprising automotive interior parts and functional components; light sport aircraft which includes carbon fiber amphibious and land-based light aircraft; and modern logistics and transportation services. …
